subsystem.name: GenericRuntimeObjects
subsystem.responsibility: Miscellaneous runtime objects shared across season/career standings, scene-order/scene management and vehicle-list management: the 104-record season standings object, per-driver career records, the 18624-stride season-scoring entries, several differently-shaped linked-list containers, scene-order nodes, and their sentinel-heavy initializers/finalizers.

summary: The packet covers generic runtime objects with no confirmed C++ owners. Largest cluster is season/career scoring: a 104-record standings object (103 opponents at 436-byte stride from base, player record at offset 44908) with season-status/race-session/race-over trailer fields, read/written from ini-style buffers and post-race scored and ranked, plus a per-driver career record that restores driver/vehicle/grid/session data into 18624-stride season-scoring entries. A second cluster manages scene data: scene-node list registration, SceneOrder list lookup/comparison on scene-order nodes, and SeasonRaces section search over the 396-stride scene array. A third cluster is vehicle-list handling: rebuild of a filtered vehicle list from a driver string and name-based search of vehicle indices. A fourth cluster is generic pointer-list containers with object-resident metadata (head/count), removal with cleanup, and destructor-style multi-field freeing. Remaining functions are standalone initializers (zero/-1 sentinel fills), accessor wrappers and a track-name copy helper. Class boundaries are GUESS-level synthesis over UNKNOWN packet owners; field offsets are grounded in the raw source operations.

function_roles.role: Assigns ascending-score grid/starting positions to vehicles: builds a 104-slot slot->score map from the active vehicle pointers (dword_7C54F0), selection-sorts it, and writes each running position via ConditionalFieldSetter to the vehicle grid field.
Constructor-style initializer writing a zero/-1 sentinel-heavy default state (0x0 and 0x8 to 0, remaining seven dwords to -1) on the audio-subsystem object; returns this.

Straight-line initializer writing the 0/-1 alternating sentinel pattern into the first six dwords of a node (0x0/0x8/0x10/0x14 to 0, 0x4/0xC to -1); shared by track-scene node allocation and career-stats options loading.

Restores a loaded career record's runtime state into the season-scoring database entry indexed by the record's vehicle index: driver name, vehicle file name, grid position and a session-state transition, all guarded by the record's active flag.

Reads career/season state from an ini-style buffer into the standings object: per-opponent slots (436-byte stride), the player slot at +44908, season-status, race-session, race-over and current-race fields; early-terminates on scene-setup dispatch codes 1 and 4.
Serializes career/season state back into an ini-style text buffer: season-status/race-session/race-over/current-race keys, the Player section and one indexed section per active opponent slot.

After a race, scores season points for the player and every active driver entry, then ranks active drivers by position value and stores the rank count; latches the race-over flag so the computation runs once.
Stops the SceneOrder audio channel and returns the resulting SceneOrder list count, or 0 when no list was produced; cdecl helper for commentary and countdown paths.
Walks the season entity collection (player plus active entries), sums a per-entity dword (element 102) for every entity whose 32-byte scene name matches the argument, and returns the total.

Counts season scene-path entries whose per-name computed value (from sub_4C13C0) exceeds the reference value for a target name, flagging already-visited same-name entries so each name is counted once.

Removes a node from a this-owned singly-linked list: relinks head/auxiliary/count metadata, conditionally frees the node payload (PitStopMemoryCleanup + free) and the node itself, returning 1 on success.
Reads the 'Career' section from a settings-file handle into a stack structure and writes the parsed career stats into this via CareerStatsWriter; returns 1 on a successful read+parse.
Null-safe delegated field accessor: dereferences the list node held by this and returns the dword at offset 0xB144 of the resolved season object, else 0.
Dereferences the list node held by this and, when non-null, runs the standings ranking computation on the payload, returning the low byte of its result (0 for a null node).

Dedup-registers a named track scene node into the scene-node list: parses scene data, resolves the current scene-array entry, allocates/initializes a 24-byte node, copies two entry strings, wraps it in a 12-byte list node and appends it.

Destructor-style cleanup releasing every pointer field: frees a node list (head at +0x3D4) with per-node payload/resource/node frees, then null-guards and frees seven direct pointer fields of the object.

Clears and rebuilds the vehicle selection list from a driver/filter string: full-grid fallback (one node per grid slot) or tokenized default/AND/NOT groups applied via the vehicle-list filters; returns the NOT-group exclusion count.

Searches the vehicle-index list (cursor at +0x10 from head at +0x8) for a node whose vehicle name matches, resolving each index through the 1060-stride vehicle array and recording the 0-based match position in +0x18.
Returns the string-keyed linked-list result for the 'SeasonRaces' section, keyed by an explicit key or by the current scene-array entry name (base + 396*index + 260); gated by a name-lookup check.
stdcall wrapper copying the global track-name buffer (0x005C6984) into a caller destination via StringCopyWithValidation; returns the copy helper's result unchanged.
Finds a node's position in the SceneOrder list by matching the scene-array entry name: seeds the +0xC slot with the 0x7FFFFFFF sentinel, scans the list, and stores the matching node index.

Comparison functor ordering filter/property nodes by SceneOrder slot value (+0xC), tie-broken by scene-name strings resolved through the scene array (stride 396, name at +260) with a node-name fallback.

classes.name: SeasonStandingsState
classes.responsibility: 104-record (436-byte stride) season standings object: 103 opponent records, the player record at offset 44908, and a trailing block holding season-status, race-session and race-over fields. Reads/writes career season state from ini-style buffers and computes post-race rankings.

classes.name: CareerRecord
classes.responsibility: 436-byte per-driver career/season record: driver name at +0x0, vehicle file name at +0x8, vehicle index at +0x1A4, grid value at +0x1A8, session parameter at +0x1AC and active flag at +0x1B0. One instance per standings slot; the player record is the last slot (its +0x1B0 active flag is the object-level +0xB11C). Restores the runtime state into a season-scoring entry.

classes.name: SeasonScoringEntry
classes.responsibility: 18624-byte-stride season-scoring database entry (array base dword_7D2E48) into which a career record is restored: grid position written through ConditionalFieldSetter at +0x4034, grid write-back at +0x4088, driver name at +0x4620 and vehicle file name at +0x4714 (byte_5EA438 as the null-string fallback).

classes.name: VehicleSlotRecord
classes.responsibility: Per-vehicle grid-assignment record read and written during starting-grid ordering: the sort score (+18192) and sort/slot-index (+18580) fields read from each active vehicle pointer, and the grid position field at +0x4034 written through ConditionalFieldSetter. The entry base used is unk_5F070C (VEH[0]+0x4034) with the same 18624-byte stride as SeasonScoringEntry, but the two arrays are not merged.

classes.name: SeasonEntityCollection
classes.responsibility: Collection of season entities (player plus active entries) that supports per-index entity resolution (ActiveEntityCounter / FixedOffsetReturn / ShortComputation_13a0) and 32-byte scene-name lookup; used to sum season points and count matching scene paths.

classes.name: RuntimePtrList
classes.responsibility: Singly-linked list whose head and auxiliary/count metadata lives on the owning object (head at +0x0, count at +0xC); removal relinks around the node, decrements the count and conditionally frees payload and node.

classes.name: RuntimeListNode
classes.responsibility: 12-byte list node: data/payload pointer at +0x0, forward link at +0x4, ownership flag byte at +0x8; when the flag is set the payload is released on node removal.

classes.name: SeasonDataListNode
classes.responsibility: Linked-list node whose payload is a season-standings object; provides a null-safe delegated accessor (0xB144) and a conditional ranking trigger used during season-data cleanup.

classes.name: CareerStatsObject
classes.responsibility: Object that reads its own 'Career' stats section from a settings-file handle into a stack structure and commits the parsed values via CareerStatsWriter.

classes.name: SceneNodeList
classes.responsibility: Head/tail/count scene-node list (metadata at +0x10/+0x14/+0x18/+0x1C) that registers named track scene nodes with dedup by name and appends wrapped 24-byte scene nodes.

classes.name: TrackSceneNode
classes.responsibility: 24-byte track scene node block holding two strings copied from the scene entry; its first six dwords receive the 0/-1 alternating sentinel pattern from AlternatingInit on allocation.

classes.name: VehicleDataContainer
classes.responsibility: Vehicle data container whose destructor-style cleanup releases a node list (head at +0x3D4, nodes with payload at +8 and next at +0x10) plus seven direct pointer fields; invoked from vehicle file/data loading paths.

classes.name: VehicleSelectionList
classes.responsibility: Vehicle index/selection list container (head +0x8, tail +0xC, iterator +0x10, count +0x14, auxiliary/match-position +0x18) rebuilt from a driver/filter string and searched by vehicle name.

classes.name: SceneOrderNode
classes.responsibility: SceneOrder list node: scene index at +0x0, node name at +0x4, SceneOrder slot at +0xC; resolves its own position in the SceneOrder list and compares two nodes by slot value then scene name.

classes.name: SceneDataManager
classes.responsibility: Scene-data management helpers operating on the global scene array (dword_8AC490, index dword_8AC48C, 396-byte stride) and the SceneOrder audio channel: scene-order list size reporting and SeasonRaces section lookup.

classes.name: TrackNameProvider
classes.responsibility: Provides the global track-name buffer to session/server and game-filter setup paths via a stdcall copy wrapper.

classes.name: AudioSubsystemState
classes.responsibility: Audio-subsystem object whose constructor-style initializer writes a zero/-1 sentinel-heavy default state across nine dwords during audio subsystem setup.

transitions.trigger: RaceStandingsRankingsComputation runs when the race-over flag (+0xB150) is clear and the race-session value (+0xB14C) equals 7, then sets the flag so the scoring/ranking does not repeat.

interfaces.name: GridFieldSetter
interfaces.purpose: Shared write primitive for the grid/starting-position field: ConditionalFieldSetter is invoked both by starting-grid ordering and by career-record restore to write a position value into a 18624-stride entry's grid field.

interfaces.name: NameComparison
interfaces.purpose: Shared string/name comparison (sub_588410) used by scene-path counting, driver-list token classification, vehicle-name search, SceneOrder slot matching and SceneOrder sorting; zero/negative result semantics are inferred from control flow.

compatibility_contracts.name: SeasonStandingsRecordLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement must keep the standings object as 104 records of 436 bytes each: opponents at 436*index from the base, the player record at offset 44908, the active-flag byte at record+0x1B0, position at record+0x198, rank at record+0x19C, and the season-status (+0xB144), race-session (+0xB14C) and race-over (+0xB150) trailer fields at the object level.

compatibility_contracts.name: GridPositionFieldAt0x4034
compatibility_contracts.description: Both starting-grid ordering and career restore write the grid/starting position through ConditionalFieldSetter into field +0x4034 of a 18624-stride entry (vehicle slots and season-scoring entries). Shared offset does not prove the two arrays are the same object.

compatibility_contracts.name: SceneArrayLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement must keep the global scene array addressable as base dword_8AC490 plus 396 * dword_8AC48C with the scene name at entry+260 and a secondary string at entry+4, as used by track-scene registration, SeasonRaces lookup, SceneOrder slot matching and scene sorting.

compatibility_contracts.name: SeasonScoringEntryLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: A replacement restoring career data must write, into the 18624-stride entry indexed from dword_7D2E48: grid position at +0x4034 (via ConditionalFieldSetter), grid write-back at +0x4088, driver name at +0x4620 and vehicle file name at +0x4714, using byte_5EA438 as the null-string fallback.

compatibility_contracts.name: SceneOrderNodeLayout
compatibility_contracts.description: Scene-order nodes expose a scene index at +0x0, a node name at +0x4 and a SceneOrder slot at +0xC (seeded with 0x7FFFFFFF when unresolved); sorting and slot-finding depend on these three fields and the 396-stride scene array.

unresolved: All packet owners are UNKNOWN; every class here is worker GUESS synthesis, not confirmed C++ ownership.
The exact semantics of the vehicle fields used by SortDriverInitOrder (score at +18192, sort index at +18580) and the meaning of the value written to +0x4034 are inferred from call context only.

dword_7D2E48 is unverified as base vs pointer; the season-scoring entry stride equals the vehicle-slot stride and both carry a grid field at +0x4034, but per rule 8 the two 18624-stride arrays are kept as separate classes (VehicleSlotRecord vs SeasonScoringEntry) until common ownership is proven.
The standings record layout (436-byte stride, base slot, player record at 44908) and the sizes of the standings slots are derived from raw-source arithmetic, not an independent field table.

AlternatingInit (0x004C03A0) is invoked both on track-scene nodes and by PlayerCareerStatsGameOptionsLoader for a career-stats object; those two object types share the 0/-1 sentinel pattern but are not proven to be the same class.

CareerRecord field offsets overlap SeasonStandingsState absolute offsets (player active flag at +0xB11C equals the player record's +0x1B0 at base 44908); the two classes are kept separate because the packet does not prove the career record and the standings slot are identical.

sub_588410 is treated throughout as a strcmp-like comparison where zero means equality and a negative result means first-sorts-before-second; that semantic is DERIVED from control-flow tests, not independently evidenced.
LinkedListCount (in SceneOrderReader) and StringKeyedLinkedListSearch (in SeasonRacesSectionFinder) are referenced only in raw-source text and are not listed as callees in this packet.
The early-termination dispatch codes (1 and 4) and the SessionStateTransition second argument (0) in CareerSeasonStateFileReader/CopyDriverDataToScoringDB have unresolved meaning.
The meaning of dword element 102 of a season entity and whether sub_4C13C0's result is a points value used as a threshold in PathFileComparisonCounter are unresolved.

Semantic roles of this[1]/this[2] in LinkedListNodeRemovalWithCleanup, of SceneNodeList secondary (+0x18), and of the ownership byte + PitStopMemoryCleanup payload contract are not independently confirmed.
RuntimePtrList and the various list containers differ in head offsets (+0x0 vs +0x8 vs +0x10); they are modeled as distinct classes, not one generic list.

VehicleSelectionList merges ParseDriverListString and SeasonSceneMatchByIndex on shared head/iterator offsets, but the packet does not prove both operate on the same object type; the +0x14 field read in SeasonSceneMatchByIndex is flagged unresolved.
SceneOrderSlotFinder's return value varies by path (match, null, array base) and is not a single status code; the caller sub_4C5C80's purpose is not established.
TrackSceneNode's 24-byte block fields beyond the alternating sentinel pattern (which slots hold the two copied strings) are not evidenced.
Global byte_5EA438 content and the config-block globals dword_5D30C0..byte_5D30D8 in ParseDriverListString have unresolved meaning.
Whether dword_8AD3B4 (GameDataDir) is consumed by AudioChannelStop in SceneOrderReader, SeasonRacesSectionFinder and SceneOrderSlotFinder is undetermined.
